description: React component for the main app in a Next.js frontend, handling persona generation, uploading documents, state management, and orchestration of backend calls for AI persona building.

methods.name: asStringArray
methods.description: Converts an unknown value to a string array, filtering out non-string and empty values.

methods.name: isNonEmptyObject
methods.description: Type guard to check if a value is a non-null object with keys.

methods.name: getInitials
methods.description: Returns initials for a display label, extracting up to two initials from the provided string.

methods.name: getNestedOrchestrationValue
methods.description: Safely accesses nested values within an object given a path array; returns value and found path.

methods.name: logAvailableKeys
methods.description: Logs top-level and nested 'artifacts' keys in an object for debugging.

methods.name: extractPersonaJsonFromOrchestrationRecord
methods.description: Extracts persona JSON object from an orchestration record by checking multiple candidate paths.

methods.name: coercePersonaDataFromBackendJson
methods.description: Maps backend persona JSON shapes into the frontend's PersonaData structure, supporting multiple formats.

methods.name: fingerprintPersonaData
methods.description: Creates a fingerprint string of PersonaData for change detection.

methods.name: fingerprintPersonaArtifact
methods.description: Creates a fingerprint of a persona JSON artifact shape for change detection.

methods.name: handleGenerateDraft
methods.description: Handles generating a persona draft by uploading documents and orchestrating backend processes.

methods.name: handleSaveChanges
methods.description: Saves modified persona data to backend.

methods.name: handleFinalize
methods.description: Finalizes the persona, setting the state accordingly.

methods.name: handleRegenerateDraft
methods.description: Re-generates the persona draft from existing build data.

methods.name: removeSkill
methods.description: Removes a skill from the persona's skills list.

methods.name: addSkill
methods.description: Adds a skill to the persona's skills list.

methods.name: handleProfileImageChange
methods.description: Handles updating the persona's profile image from file input.

methods.name: removeExperience
methods.description: Removes an experience entry from the persona.

methods.name: fingerprintPersonaData
methods.description: Creates a fingerprint string of PersonaData for change detection.

methods.name: fingerprintPersonaArtifact
methods.description: Creates a fingerprint string for a persona JSON artifact shape for change detection.
